contentBlocks.text: You've read two chapters about Mira. Today, read the final chapter and put the whole story in order!

Chapter 3: 'By the end of the day, Mira and the boy, whose name was Sam, had already made plans to sit together again tomorrow. Walking home, Mira realized her stomach didn't feel tight anymore. It felt light, like she was walking on air.' Now retell the whole story in order: what happened first (Chapter 1), then next (Chapter 2), then last (Chapter 3)? Use the words 'first,' 'then,' and 'finally' in your retelling.
You just retold a whole 3-chapter story in the right order! Tomorrow we'll figure out a tricky word from the story using clues, not a dictionary.

objectives: Read the final chapter of the week's story
Retell the full 3-chapter story in correct sequence using signal words (first, then, finally)
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review Chapters 1 and 2 briefly.
2. Read Chapter 3 together.
3. Have the child retell the full story in order using signal words.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's vocabulary-in-context lesson.
differentiationTips: Struggling: retell the story together first, sentence by sentence, before the child retells it independently
Ready for more: ask the child to explain how Mira's feeling changed from the beginning to the end of the story
This connects last week's writing-organization skills (topic/details/closing) to reading — a story's sequence works the same way a paragraph does
teacherGuide.answerKey: First, Mira felt nervous on her first day. Then, she bravely sat with a boy named Sam even though she was scared. Finally, they became friends and her nervous feeling turned into a light, happy feeling.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Directly addresses Common Core Grade 3 Reading standard RL.3.5 (referring to parts of a story using terms like chapter, and describing how each part builds on earlier sections), completing the week's story before tomorrow's vocabulary focus.

generationData.instructions: Retell the whole story in order using first, then, and finally.
